body.label: Effect
body.html: On success, deal 1 Bludgeoning Damage. Until your next turn, ignore the Movement penalty from one Light physical Wound Condition.

surges.html: Deal +1 Damage if you have a Core Wound.
On a hit, push the target 1 unit.

rider.title: Combo - Opener
rider.html: If hit, you may enter Tiger Stance: while you have a Core Wound, the first Prowess hit on your turn grants 1 additional Combo; your Composure is reduced by 1.
